headline: AURA ENERGY TIRIS BFS: $500M NPV AT $90/LB URANIUM, AISC $41.25 — MAURITANIA PROJECT EYES 2028 FIRST ORE
snippet: Aura Energy (ASX: AEE) released its Bankable Feasibility Study for the Tiris Uranium Project in Mauritania on October 19, reporting a post-tax NPV of US$500.3 million and a 28% IRR at US$90/lb uranium, underpinned by an industry-low AISC of US$41.25/lb — a 54% margin at current long-term contract prices. A US$400 million funding plan and a December 2026 final investment decision gate first ore in 2028.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD FIRMS AS OIL RETREATS FROM 5-MONTH HIGH — FED MEETING OCT 27-28 KEEPS BOTH METALS IN CHECK
snippet: GoldSeek's Monday report notes that crude oil's retreat from a five-month high released some inflation-driven pressure on gold, allowing spot to edge higher toward $4,181 with silver firming 0.8% to $58.22. The move is tentative — the October 27-28 Federal Reserve meeting and an upcoming CPI print keep traders on the sidelines, leaving precious metals in a technical holding pattern that analysts say typically resolves in the direction of the Fed's tone.

headline: BHP CHILE TENTATIVE DEAL EASES COPPER SUPPLY FEAR — LME SLIDES TO $14,342/T AS LME STOCKS EDGE HIGHER
snippet: LME three-month copper fell Monday to approximately US$14,342 per tonne as BHP reached a tentative labour agreement at its major Chilean operation, reducing the near-term supply-disruption premium that had kept prices elevated. Rising LME warehouse inventories added a second bearish signal; however, the ongoing Centinela strike (Antofagasta) and a 33% prediction-market probability of Section 232 tariffs on US copper cable by year-end continue to underpin a structural price floor.

headline: BENZ MINING ICON GOLD CAMP VALIDATES SCALE — MULTIPLE THICK HIGH-GRADE HITS IN LATEST WESTERN AUSTRALIA ROUND
snippet: Benz Mining (ASX: BNZ, TSX-V: BZ) released its latest batch of assays from the Icon Gold Camp in Western Australia's Glenburgh District, reporting multiple broad, high-grade gold intercepts that continue to expand the known footprint. The company is targeting a maiden resource in 2027 across the Hurricane, Icon, and Thunderbolt trends; less than 30% of the three-kilometre Icon trend has been systematically drilled, leaving significant upside in the resource conversion program.

headline: GOLD X2 MINING INTERSECTS 172M AT 0.96 G/T AU IN INFILL DRILLING — TSX-V JUNIOR TIGHTENS RESOURCE GRID
snippet: Gold X2 Mining (TSX-V: AUXX) reported infill drill results returning a combined 172.0 metres grading 0.96 g/t gold, tightening the geological model in preparation for an upcoming resource update. The wide, bulk-tonnage interval is consistent with open-pit economics, and the continued infill program suggests the company is advancing toward a preliminary economic assessment.

headline: EXIRO NICKEL ASSUMES VALE'S THOMPSON COMPLEX — CONSORTIUM COMMITS $200M TO REVIVE CANADA'S LARGEST NICKEL OPERATION
snippet: Exiro Nickel Company completed its takeover of Vale's Thompson Mine Complex in Northern Manitoba on October 16, with a consortium of Orion Resource Partners and Canada Growth Fund holding 81.1% and Vale retaining 18.9% alongside a multi-year offtake agreement for concentrate production. The consortium has committed up to US$200 million in capital to revitalise what was once Canada's largest primary nickel operation — a major development for TSX-V nickel investors watching the Canada-US critical minerals supply push.

headline: FARADAY COPPER CLOSES BHP'S SAN MANUEL DEAL — BHP TAKES 32% STAKE, 24,000M ARIZONA DRILL PROGRAM LAUNCHES
snippet: Faraday Copper (TSX-V: FDY) closed its acquisition of BHP's San Manuel property in Pinal County, Arizona on October 15, issuing 131.6 million shares that give BHP a 32% non-diluted stake valued at $657.9 million. San Manuel and Copper Creek are now combined into the Redhawk Copper Complex, with a 24,000-metre confirmation drill program mobilising immediately to verify the historical 3-billion-pound copper resource estimate.

headline: RINEHART-BACKED ARAFURA EXPANDS US RARE EARTHS OFFTAKE 70% — NOLANS NdPr TO FEED US PROJECT VAULT RESERVE
snippet: Arafura Rare Earths (ASX: ARU) signed a binding five-year offtake agreement with Traxys North America for 850 tonnes per year of NdPr oxide from its Nolans Project in Australia — a 70% expansion on the May 2026 term sheet — with supply designated for Project Vault, the US government's strategic critical minerals stockpile. The deal adds commercial substance to Arafura's project financing push and underlines the US government's urgency to lock in non-Chinese rare earth supply chains.

headline: VOLTA DOUBLES SPRINGER RARE EARTHS RESOURCE, TARGETS 2027 PRELIMINARY ECONOMIC STUDY
snippet: Volta Mineral Resources doubled the mineral resource estimate at its Springer rare earths project and announced plans for a 2027 preliminary economic assessment, adding scale to a project that is being advanced as part of the broader Western push to diversify critical minerals supply away from China. The resource expansion comes as government-backed financing programs in the US and Australia are actively seeking non-Chinese rare earth supply.
